analysis: Overture source provenance by official tract and provided stratum

data_and_restrictions.official_scope: four authoritative regional sample GEOID lists; any source table rows outside these IDs are excluded
data_and_restrictions.tract_geometry: provided ACS GEOID/geometry used only for bbox-center assignment to official sample tracts
data_and_restrictions.use_in_scored_predictions: source-mix shares are stored in the feature cache for discovery only and are not read by estimate_one or candidate output

interpretation: descriptive source-attribution analysis; source mentions do not prove feature correctness or local community mapping activity

source_definitions.building_esri: any dataset name starting with Esri; observed label includes Esri Community Maps
source_definitions.building_microsoft: any dataset name starting with Microsoft; observed label includes Microsoft ML Buildings
source_definitions.building_osm_share: fraction of assigned building records with any dataset name equal to OSM or starting with OpenStreetMap
source_definitions.note: Sources are multi-valued; membership shares may overlap. The exclusive classes are also reported to show a disjoint partition.
source_definitions.poi_meta: fraction of assigned POIs with any source dataset named meta
source_definitions.poi_microsoft: fraction of assigned POIs with any source dataset starting with Microsoft
source_definitions.poi_non_meta: 1 minus the per-place meta source-membership share; includes Microsoft, other upstream sources, and places without a named upstream provider
source_definitions.poi_other_upstream: fraction of assigned POIs with any source dataset other than meta, Microsoft, Overture, or Overture-signals

statistics.named_tracts: ten lowest non-null building OSM-source shares among finite-SVI q4 tracts per region, sorted by share then GEOID
statistics.spearman: per-region Spearman rank correlation with pairwise complete observations; average ranks for ties; no p-values or causal interpretation
statistics.stratum_contrasts: independent tract bootstrap of group-mean differences for q4−q1, tribal−nontribal, rural−urban, and high-vs-lower heat/drought groups; 2,000 replicates
statistics.stratum_means: unweighted mean of tract-level source shares; 95% percentile CI from 2,000 bootstrap resamples of tracts within each stratum

stratum_definitions.drought: provided usdm_summer_dsci; region-specific top quartile vs lower three
stratum_definitions.heat: provided epht_heat_days_summer; region-specific top quartile vs lower three
stratum_definitions.svi_overall: within-region quartiles q1–q4 over finite covered values; cutpoint ties assigned to higher bin
stratum_definitions.tribal_any: provided boolean overlap indicator; true and false groups

uncertainty_and_limitations: Source membership is a provenance field, not a measurement of source quality, completeness, age, or which source uniquely contributed each geometry.
Buildings/places may have multiple provider attributions; per-provider shares overlap and should not be summed as a composition.
Per-tract means give every tract equal weight; they are not population-weighted and do not measure an individual's map access.
The bootstrap reflects tract resampling only and ignores spatial dependence; correlations are descriptive, region-specific, and not adjusted for covariates.
No labels, hidden targets, external datasets, or removed reference layers were used; the analysis does not estimate organizer scores or actual map completeness.
